text:
viv: opened PR that updates migration guide + a couple of SDK snippets. preview failed due to linkcheck complaining about a redirected CDN URL. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/560

josh: are examples covered by CODEOWNERS? we keep seeing unassigned example PRs slip through. I think adding /examples/** -> @redwood/docs would help.

merge-bot: docs-preview: FAILED 
Error: linkcheck - encountered redirect for https://old-cdn.example/snippet.js (blocked)

ursula: question: if we add examples to CODEOWNERS, will that cause a ton more review requests for tiny changes (like image alt fixes)? we should pair any CODEOWNERS change with an auto-merge safety plan.

viv: agree. proposal: auto-merge allowed when ALL true: label `docs/auto-merge` added by a user, checks pass (docs-preview, md-lint, linkcheck, spellcheck), PR only touches docs/ or examples/, PR does NOT modify CODEOWNERS, no changed paths match regex `(examples/private/|\.env$|credentials|PRIVATE_KEY)`, and release-freeze check is negative.

josh: also require that the label addition event actor is type `User` (not a bot) and the workflow should grep changed files for credential strings like PRIVATE_KEY or AWS_SECRET and abort if found.

merge-bot: note: modifying CODEOWNERS triggers review requests and may delay merge until approvals satisfied. Changing CODEOWNERS should explicitly disable auto-merge for that PR.

ursula: good. add audit: the action must post a comment with who requested auto-merge, which checks were green, and the merge commit sha after merging.

viv: i'll inline the external asset to unblock preview and open a tiny CODEOWNERS PR to add /examples/**. i'll wait to request the label until CODEOWNERS is merged and the safety workflow is in place.

josh: i'll draft the GH workflow with the blocklist scan, user-label guard, freeze check, and audit comment.

(Action items: viv -> inline asset + open CODEOWNERS PR, josh -> draft GH workflow, ursula -> be human gate for initial rollouts)
